# Alexander Villanueva Porcel (Stuko)

> AI Systems Engineer based in Cochabamba, Bolivia. Builds distributed
> backends (Golang), GPU inference systems (CUDA, TensorFlow), high-throughput
> data pipelines (StarRocks, PostgreSQL) and production Kubernetes. Remote-first,
> ~4 years of experience. Spanish and English.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio (English)](https://stuko.dev/en/): Main site. Experience, featured

  pricing, FAQs and contact form.
- [Portfolio (Español)](https://stuko.dev/es/): Sitio principal en español.

## Projects

- [Alice Agent](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev): Open-source, local-first AI
  teammate CLI. Persistent memory, extensible skills, sandboxed subagents.
  Runs on your own machine.
